label: Voicemail
intent: The message plays back. Light: the take-up reel on the left starts the tape, the right reel follows a beat behind, and both run one full turn, stop dead just past their marks and tick back into place. Strong: the reels wind back first, then run two fast turns, stop harder and settle in two ticks. The tape and the rims never move; the index marks show the turn.

reel-left-mark.rotate.//: the driving reel; after the whole turns an invisible step puts the angle back on exactly 0, so the rest frame matches the first pixel for pixel

reel-right-mark.rotate.//: the following reel, pulled by the tape
